brief: A system monitor where CPU/memory are organisms — healthy breathes steady, stressed pulses fast

dominant_strengths: Strong metaphor execution: green 'breathing' vs purple 'pulsing' rings give CPU/memory immediate emotional legibility
Clean dark palette with disciplined two-hue accent system keeps the organism metaphor focused, not gimmicky
Confident typographic hierarchy — large percentages anchor each card while labels recede appropriately
dominant_weaknesses: Bottom metric cards feel disconnected — flat numerics lack any organism vocabulary, breaking the central metaphor
Static screenshot can't convey breathing/pulsing; rings look nearly identical in form, undermining the differentiation promise
Massive empty space below bottom-row icons wastes vertical real estate and weakens compositional rhythm
fix_priorities: Extend organism metaphor to temperature/network/disk/processes with micro-pulses or waveforms tied to their state
Differentiate the two main rings more structurally — pulse amplitude, frequency, or distortion, not just color
Tighten bottom card heights or add sparkline content to eliminate dead space and balance the grid
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral metaphor lands well and reflective concept is memorable, but behavioral utility is thin — actual diagnostic data is sparse.
rationale.intent_fit: Captures the organism concept clearly for the two hero metrics but fails to propagate the metaphor across the full system, leaving the brief half-realized.
